description: Versioned typed question set for Laya System 1 decision model in Email Threat Detection

verdict.instructions: What is the primary threat classification of the email in `body`?

criteria.phishing: credential harvesting, account takeover, or spoofing attempt to deceive the recipient into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious payloads
criteria.spam: unsolicited commercial email, bulk advertising, newsletters, or promotional campaigns without direct attack intent
criteria.suspicious: anomalous communications with inconclusive intent, unverified sender domains, or unusual urgency
criteria.legitimate: authentic internal or external business communication, service notification, or personal email

credential_harvesting.instructions: Does the email in `body` attempt to solicit passwords, payment cards, verification codes, or login credentials?

sender_impersonation.instructions: Does the sender attempt to impersonate a trusted entity, executive, technical support team, or bank?

urgency_pressure.instructions: How much psychological urgency, threat of account termination, or coercive pressure is exerted in `body`?
criteria: no artificial urgency or neutral tone
moderate urgency with a reasonable timeframe
extreme urgency threatening immediate loss, suspension, or penalty within 24 hours
